Membeth. "Windglockenspiel.Koshi.ogg"; stephan, "Windchime.ogg". Wikimedia Commons, CC0 / public domain. A Koshi chime and a wind chime in a breeze, used as wind-chime gusts.

stamperadam. Celesta samples, CC0, via Sonatina Symphonic Orchestra (Mattias Westlund). Freesound. Celesta C4-C6 (hard strikes), CC0 per the Sonatina README.

University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios. <i>Musical Instrument Samples</i>: crotales and vibraphone (2012). theremin.music.uiowa.edu. Crotales C6-C8 and vibraphone C4-E5, ff; the site says the samples may be used for any projects without restrictions.

Versilian Studios. <i>VSCO 2 Community Edition</i>. CC0 1.0, GitHub, github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE. Tubular bells (C4 G4 C5 F5), glockenspiel (G4-C7) and metal wind-chime sweeps and gust used in the Ambient Generator; CC0.
:::
